approved_payload.content: A man was arrested on Monday 19 October during an intelligence-led police operation at premises in Musina suspected of being used to store large quantities of illicit cigarettes (Limpopo police spokesperson Col Malesela Ledwaba, via Limpopo Mirror, 21 October). Police say they recovered 55 boxes and 46 cartons of Remington Gold cigarettes valued at about R1.5 million, and seized two vehicles worth about R600,000 together. He faces charges of possession and transportation of illicit cigarettes and was expected to appear in the Musina Magistrate's Court on 21 October; the outcome of that appearance is not reported in the saved source. Police describe the target as an alleged illicit cigarette syndicate and say the suspected syndicate leader and four others fled and are being traced. The syndicate is a police allegation; no court has found one, no one has been convicted, and the accused is not named here. Case status: charged; court outcome not reported. One report, resting on a police statement. The map point is estimated: the premises are not identified, so the pin is the Musina police station point, a reference within the town.
